title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — September 30, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C8.6 (Peaked September 30, 2026 at 02:46 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 280 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Nothing unusual at the moment. 🤍💫

A broad dark coronal region stands out near the Sun’s center, while sunspot coverage and coronagraph structures remain modest.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
